test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The battle of Kohima was fought in 1944 between :

options.text: Japanese forces and Communist Chinese forces
Royal Burmese Army and British Indian Army
Imperial Japanese forces and British Indian forces
Chinese forces and British Indian forces

solution:
The correct answer is__ **Imperial Japanese forces and British Indian forces**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Battle of Kohima was the turning point of the Japanese U-Go offensive into India in 1944, during **World War II .**
 
• This battle was fought in** three stages from April 4 to June 22, 1944, **around the town of Kohima
 
• The** Japanese defeat at Kohima and Impha**l was the largest up until that time
 
• In March 1944, the Japanese came in through the dense jungles of the region from Burma into India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The plan was to attack the** northeast of India through Burma**.
 
• There was a British garrison at Kohima, today** the capital of the state of Nagaland.** 
 
• The Japanese forces wished to attack the garrison and take Kohima after which they would take Assam and then march on to Delhi
 
• During the Battle of Kohima, the British and** Indian forces had lost 4,064 men, dead, missing and wounded**
 
• One such slice of history is the Battle for Kohima-Imphal, which was a decisive turning point in the war. 
 
• It ended with the first major defeat suffered by Japanese forces in the Burma theatre and thwarted their ambitious plans to invade India

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__****

 
• World War II or the Second World War, often abbreviated as WWII or WW2, was a** global war that lasted from 1939 to 1945**
 
• It involved the vast majority of the world's countries—including all of the great powers—forming** two opposing military alliances: the Allies and the Axis** powers
 
• In a total war directly involving **more than 100 million personnel from more than 30 countries**,
 
• the major participants threw their entire economic, industrial, and scientific capabilities
